text:
maya.rivera: Quick sync — after yesterday's quantization sweep on `rp-v2-q4` we see a concentrated quality regression on the "refusal/overly-safe" cohort. Error rate up ~8% on the golden testset.
sam.chen: Ugh. Is that the 4bit path only or also fp16 runs?
maya.rivera: Looks like 4-bit only, fp16 numbers are ~flat. Spike correlates with kv-cache changes in the new kernel.
alok.patel: Do we have diffs on prompt-level failures? Can we isolate by prompt family?
maya.rivera: Yes — uploading sample hits to the shared drive now. Quick summary: most failures are short-instruction prompts where the model now defaults to refuse. Examples in the drive.
jen.park: I'm flagging this to annotators. We should refresh the golden pool to include more of those short-instruction edge cases before relabeling.
priya.kapoor: Capacity note — our annotator SLA is already at ~85% utilization this week. If we expand the golden set by 2x we'll need overflow labeling or slower turnaround.
sam.chen: Can we do targeted augmentation instead of doubling the whole pool? i.e., add ~500 short-instruction anchors and keep the rest as-is.
maya.rivera: That seems reasonable. Proposal: add 600 targeted anchors sampled from the failing cohort (stratified by taxonomy), de-dup against current golden using fingerprint threshold 0.92, then run quick relabel QA pass.
alok.patel: For dedup fingerprinting, FYI the new hashing change moved from murmur3->sha1-trunc which increased collision sensitivity. We should keep threshold conservative; 0.92 might be too low.
jen.park: Suggest 0.95 for sha1-trunc, and add manual review for near-threshold matches (0.93-0.96) in the UI.
priya.kapoor: Operationally: if we do 600 new anchors + manual review, ETA for complete golden refresh is 5 business days with current staffing. We can compress to 3 days if we pull 2 contractors.
maya.rivera: Also need to freeze new label batches for the downstream evals while we relabel — to avoid mixing label versions in regression tracking.
sam.chen: Agree. Put a short freeze on new production label ingestion for the eval pipeline and route new work to a separate backlog tag `post-quant-queue`.
label-bot: auto-note: Created backlog tag `post-quant-queue` and set annotation TTL to 14 days. :white_check_mark:
jen.park: Quick checklist:
- [ ] sample 600 anchors (maya)
- [ ] dedup with sha1-trunc @0.95, flag 0.93-0.96 (alok)
- [ ] push to annotator pool; hire 2 contractors if ETA must be <4d (priya)
- [ ] freeze new eval ingestion (sam)
- [ ] run relabel QA and update golden (maya + jen)
maya.rivera: I'll start sampling now and post the sample link. If anyone has bandwidth for manual near-threshold review ping me.
sam.chen: I'll update the rollout plan to hold the `rp-v2-q4` quantized rollout until golden refresh completes + pass on a small sanity eval (5k prompts).
alok.patel: Also capture kernel metrics and config diff to correlate — I'll attach the kernel patch and perf traces.
priya.kapoor: Noted — I'll open a short budget request for 2 contractors and set priority to P2.
maya.rivera: Thanks everyone. I'll post regular updates in this thread. :thumbsup:
